data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Hoseias (הושעיהς) comes from the root words ‘hoshi’a (ישע) which mean ‘salvation’ or ‘rescue’. The name Hoseias is a clear reminder that God is our savior and protector. The name Hoseias carries the meaning “God saves” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Hoseias usually hope their child will grow to embody god saves and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's saving grace and protection.
data.etymology: Hoseias belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God saves.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hoseias total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.name: Ωσηε
in_greek.long_meaning: Ωσηε είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του εβραϊκού ονόματος הושע, που σημαίνει 'σωτηρία από τον Κύριο'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από την Π旧 Testamentum και ήταν το όνομα ενός από τους σημαντικότερους προφήτες της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης.

in_latin.name: Hoseas
in_latin.long_meaning: Hoseas est nomen hebraicum quod significat 'Salus a Domino'. Nomen est derivatum ex prophetia Hoseae in Vetere Testamento, cui liber Hoseae est attributus. Propheta Hoseas fuit unus ex principalibus prophetis Israeliticis.

in_english.name: Hoseias
in_english.long_meaning: Hoseias is a Christian name derived from the Hebrew name הושע (Hoshia), meaning 'Salvation is from the Lord'. The name originates from the Old Testament prophet Hosea, who was a major prophet in the Hebrew Bible. The name signifies spiritual salvation and divine providence, reflecting the importance of faith in Christian tradition.

historical_references.context: Prophet Hosea was called by God to be a prophet during the Northern Kingdom of Israel's rebellion against God's law and idolatry. Hosea was instructed by God to marry a promiscuous woman named Gomer as a symbolic representation of Israel's unfaithfulness to God.

In modern times, the name Hosea has seen usage in various contexts. On Goodreads, users can find multiple books with the title 'Hosea' in the 'Biblical Studies' section. Some of these books are commentaries on the prophet's book, while others explore its themes, such as love and redemption. On YouTube, videos about the prophet Hosea and his teachings are common in the 'Spirituality' and 'Biblical Studies' categories. Quora, an online question-and-answer platform, has numerous threads dedicated to discussing the prophet and his Book. The name Hosea is also used in personal development contexts, with some individuals adopting it as a personal name or inspiration for their own journey towards self-improvement.
